resolution: Root-caused why no [edit-latency] line appeared: the dev terminal only surfaces warn+ severities (console.log/warn/error all route through emitJsLog with a severity in v8_bindings_core.zig, and only warn+ reaches the terminal — every line the user DOES see, PLACEFREEZE and the old heartbeat, is console.warn). The edit-latency readout used console.log, so it logged into the void. Switched it to console.warn so it shows up next to the lines the user is already watching: '[js.warn] [edit-latency] place gesture→push X ms · gesture→rendered ~Y ms'. Cart-side TS — hot-reloads, no rebuild. Bundle clean. Note for the optimization phase: the PLACEFREEZE lines the user pasted are real signal — a deferred snapshot flush (editors/sessions.ts) of ~90ms per commit across 12 streams — a concrete latency target once we start driving the numbers down.
